XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Failure of the parking assistance system to warn of obstacles behind the vehicle
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ELECTRONICS | ADAS | B10F514 | BUZZER | SIGNALLING | ACOUSTIC | AUDIBLE | BUMPER | SENSORS | DETECTION | ASSISTANCE | LOUDSPEAKER | WARNING | ALERT | MANOEUVRE | REVERSING |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: ADAS

  • Device: Front parking warning buzzer

  • Fault: During parking manoeuvres, no audible warning is given for the presence of rear obstacles; when reverse gear is engaged, a general hazard warning light comes on

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: B10F514

  • Cause: Defective front parking sensor buzzer

• Action: Replace the front warning buzzer

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The front warning buzzer is located in the upper driver's compartment, above the pedals near the clutch pedal behind the protective plastic cover.
    To access the front warning buzzer, it is necessary to remove both the protective plastic cover under the steering wheel and the knee airbag.
    After replacing the rear warning buzzer, it is not necessary to perform any reprogramming via diagnostics, however, it is necessary to clear the errors in the memory via diagnostics.
